notes.title: Rugby Champions Now Released!
notes.content:
[h1]So, you want to play Rugby?[/h1]

You can now.

Step 1: Buy and Install Rugby Champions
Step 2: Pick up your controller
Step 3: Play the match!

[h1]Features[/h1]

5 Difficulty Modes.
Fluid passing.
2019 Tournament format.
Advanced AI provides a genuine challenge to suit any skill level.
Detailed stats.
Half lengths from 7 to 40 minutes.
Players and jersey customisation.
Share rosters with other gamers.
Full Match Replays let you re-watch entire games.

[previewyoutube=oYj585rk_mM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Game Has Been Updated
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new version has been made available for you. Hope you continue to enjoy the game and thanks for the feedback so far.

Here are the changes:-

- Major graphical performance improvements to the 3D matches which should enable a smoother gameplay experience. This should enable live interaction to be feasible on some PC's where it was previously not possible and should enable those with high end PC's to enjoy the game on higher graphical settings if desired.

- The bug where free agents were sometimes not signing with no rejection email being sent has been fixed.

notes.title: Game Has Been Updated
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new version has been made available for you. Hope you continue to enjoy the game and thanks for the feedback so far.

Here are the changes:-

- Free agents and youth players are now generated with a preferred position when they enter the game (existing free agents and youth will remain without a preferred position in any games you have in progress)

- The preferred position of all youth players is now visible on the youth scouting page

- The match engine now displays a popup display when advantage starts being played, so that it is clear which team advantage is being played for and what the infringement was

- The currently selected position of any player you receive an offer on from another club is now displayed when this offer is being presented

- Updates to player database, including the addition of former All Black Zac Guildford to USO Nevers

- Game balance adjustments to the Free Agent player market

notes.title: Game Has Been Updated
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

A new version has been made available for you.  Hope you continue to enjoy the game and thanks for the feedback so far.

Here are the changes:-

- Some updates to the player database

- Preferred position is now visible for selected players when making in-game substitutions

- An 'Export Player Data' button has been added to the squad selection page which allows you to export your team’s data to spreadsheet for analysis. English language users export to comma separated format and French language users to semi colon separated format.

- A fix has been applied which should resolve the issue of a small UI on high resolution displays
